None present either on behalf of applicant or on behalf opposite party no.2.
Sri Vijay Bahadur Maurya, learned AGA for the State are present.

2. The instant bail cancellation application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to cancel the bail granted to opposite party no.2 vide order dated 02.08.2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 215 of 2021, under Sections 406, 504, 506, 354B, 376(3) IPC, 67 I.T. Act and 9/10 and 5/6 POCSO Act,
Police Station Parashrampur, District Basti.
3.

The instant bail cancellation application is pending since the year 2023 and even today none is present to press the same, therefore, it reflects, either applicant has lost the interest in the matter or by efflux of time, the instant bail cancellation application has become infructuous.
4. In view of above, the instant bail cancellation application stands dismissed.
